studies.construct: Creative reasoning: analysis, useful originality and ingenuity under constraints
studies.independent_criterion: Unseen creative engineering task, blind expert rating of novelty and requirement satisfaction
studies.falsifier: The session fails to predict useful creative engineering work or adds no stable information after rivals and other sessions.

studies.construct: Role-relevant technical and product design judgment
studies.independent_criterion: Unseen design work sample and later blind review of design artifacts or changes
comparators: Equal-time written or diagrammed design task
studies.falsifier: The verbal case fails to predict independent design quality or provides less value than an equal-time work sample.
preregistration_gaps: Select role level and task domain

studies.construct: Cooperation judgment and communication in a work conflict
studies.independent_criterion: Observed team coordination exercise and later role-relevant collaboration evidence
studies.falsifier: Stated cooperative strategy does not transfer to observed cooperation or adds no stable value beyond the other sessions.
